issue.title: Retire link_rail
issue.description: Beta gate for the ACE link rail, link-following keys, and links panel.

task_type_fields.remove_when: The rail, follow keys, trail, and links panel have landed with visual and both-state coverage.
task_type_fields.when_disabled: ACE keeps the existing footer-only layout with no link rail, no link-following keys, and no links panel surface.
task_type_fields.when_enabled: ACE renders the selected entity's artifact-link rail above the footer and enables the unfinished link-following keys and links panel behind the same gate.

payload.entry: Flag link_rail was removed by the epic's land phase (a7b702863, bead:sase-ug.10): the Off branch and src/sase/ace/tui/link_rail_flag.py are deleted, the registry entry and sase.schema.json member are gone, and the rail/follow-keys/trail/$0-panel are unconditional. Closing the flag bead per sase_flags 'the epic removes it before it lands ... and closing the flag bead'; tools/check_feature_flags rule 8 was warning that this live bead had no definition.
